blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected the regenerated front, back, side and three-quarter renders plus all six poses. The jacket remains nearly featureless white: the broad plastron and rear waist adjustment are absent; elbow diamonds and diagonal marking are faint contour lines rather than clear constructed details.
Both sleeves and underarms retain dense irregular faceting and wrinkles in neutral, arms-up, arm-cross and prone poses. The sleeve surface remains visibly rough.

The standing overskirt has an uncontrolled, rumpled flare rather than readable ordered pleats. In crouch the skirt separates into flaps and leaves large gaps to the shorts; in sit the shorts read as oversized blunt cylindrical thigh shells with visible avatar gaps.
The collar is still a narrow upright open tube; the diagonal piping does not create a visible fencing plastron or secure-looking closure. Neck clearance is not established.
These are Blender prototype renders only. Shape Key fit, continuous penetration, accepted deformation weights, Unity prefab integration, VRChat Build & Test and SDK upload remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
